stories.title: Illinois Man Casts Mail-In Ballot. He Happens To Be The Pope.
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV submitted a mail-in ballot in his native Chicago ahead of the November 3 US midterm elections, becoming the first sitting pontiff reported to vote in a US general election. stories.summary: California voters will decide on a one-time 5% tax on billionaires that grew from an ambitious union leader’s proposal into a defining midterm issue. The campaign has divided Democrats, drawn national political attention and prompted wealthy opponents to deploy hundreds of millions of Silicon Valley dollars against it.
